en: What is this place?

jp: ここはお酒を楽しむ場所だよ
en: Welcome. This is a place for enjoying a drink.

jp: 坊やはもう少し大きくなってから
en: Come back and play when you're a bit bigger, kiddo.
He is with me.

jp: あんたはさっきの・・・
en: Well, well. You're the one from earlier...

jp: 先ほどの話の返事を聞きたい
en: I would like your answer to what we discussed earlier.

jp: 教団の情報が欲しいなら
サイファーパンクの正式な
メンバーにならないと無理よ
en: If you want Church intel, you'll have to become a full member of Cypherpunk.

jp: サイファーパンクの正式な
メンバーになれば、マティアの
en: If I become a full member of Cypherpunk, I'll find out where Matia is!?

jp: 今日明日でなれるものじゃないよ
en: Barring a special exception, that's not something you become overnight.
Well, give it three years at the very least.
Three years!!?

jp: もっとかかるかもしれないわね
en: That's right. Three years if you're lucky. Might take longer.
No way....

jp: 大切な人がさらわれたんだってね
焦る気持ちもわかるよ
en: I hear someone dear to you was taken. I understand why you're in a hurry.

jp: 世の中には想いだけじゃ
覆せないものがあるんだよ
en: ...But you know, there are things in this world feelings alone can't overturn.

jp: 気持ちだけでぶつかって
死んでいった若者の数なんて
en: I've lost count of the young ones who charged in on feelings alone and died.

jp: 死んでからじゃ後悔もできないよ
生きて多くを学ぶことだね
闇雲に走るだけがすべてじゃない
en: No regrets once you're dead. Live and learn a lot. Running blind isn't the only way.

jp: そういう前向きな想いがあるなら
＜サイファーパンク＞はいつでも
あなたたちを歓迎するわ
en: With that kind of forward-looking spirit, Cypherpunk will always welcome you.

jp: ＜特例＞があると言っていたが
en: ...But you said just now that there are special exceptions.

jp: ヴァルトス様に認められた時って
en: You mean the one where Valtoss-sama acknowledges you, right?
Exal!?
Auntie, one milk!!
Aun...

jp: 何度言ったらわかるんだい
あたしの名前はダリア！
en: How many times do I have to tell you? My name is Dahlia! Big sis Dahlia!
Yeah, yeah.

jp: それにしても、こんなところで
また会うとは思わなかったぜ
en: Anyway, never thought I'd run into you two again here.
Um...
I'm Exal. Nice to meet ya!

jp: 管轄外には首を突っ込まないって
en: Exal! How many times have I said not to poke your nose outside your jurisdiction!
I know, I know!
Honestly....

jp: 飲んだらさっさと出て行きなさい
en: Here's your milk. Drink up and get out.

jp: そっちの坊やもいるかい？
en: Want one too, kiddo?
What now?
Yes, please
No, thank you
Yes, please.
Bleh... Still tastes awful.
Huh? You don't like it?

jp: この子、ミルクが苦手なのよ
en: Ah... Pay him no mind. This one can't stand milk.
No, thank you.

jp: あんたもミルクが苦手なのかい？
en: Oh? You can't stand milk either?
Either?
Bleh... Still tastes awful.
Good grief.

jp: ・・・あんたも懲りないねぇ
嫌いなら飲まなきゃいいのに
en: ...You never learn. If you hate it, don't drink it. You'll get a bellyache again.
It's the best thing there is for growing taller!
...Even if it tastes awful.

jp: 飲んだらさっさと出て行く
en: Yeah, yeah. Drink up and get out.

jp: ちょっとくらいいいじゃん
en: Come on, let me stay a bit.

jp: なぁ、教団の情報が欲しいって
いったい何が知りたいんだ？
en: So, you want info on the Church. What exactly is it you want to know?

jp: 六翼の天使にマティアが
さらわれてしまったんだ
en: Matia was taken by a six-winged angel.
Matia?

jp: ボクの、大切な人・・・
en: Someone... very dear to me.

jp: マティアを助けたくて
何か手がかりが欲しくて
ここまで来たんだけど
en: I want to save her, so I came all this way looking for some kind of lead, but...

jp: 六翼の天使に誘拐事件か
嫌な臭いがする話だよな～
en: Huh... A six-winged angel and a kidnapping. That story stinks, doesn't it~

jp: おばちゃん、何か情報ないの？
このまま放っておくのは
en: Auntie, got any info? Don't you think it's cruel to just leave them like this?

jp: まったく、あんたは何年
en: Honestly. How many years have you been in Cypherpunk?

jp: さらわれた子を助けたい？
助けるのはいいけれど、まさか
直接教会に乗り込むつもりかい？
en: Save the kidnapped girl? Fine, but you don't mean to storm the church yourselves?

jp: 全面戦争にでもなったら
en: One wrong move and it turns into all-out war. Then what?

jp: 今のこの組織の勢力では
火を見るより明らかだろう
en: With the strength Cypherpunk has now, the outcome would be plain as day.
Exactly.

jp: 私たちの思想は教団の教えに
反していても、教団と戦争する
ための集まりじゃない
en: Our beliefs defy the Church's teachings, but we're not here to wage war on it.

jp: そういう事になるとしても
まだ時期ではないというわけか
en: Even if it comes to that one day, the time is not yet ripe. Is that it?

jp: 部外者のあんたの方が
状況をわかってるじゃないか
en: You're an outsider, and you understand the situation better than he does.

jp: そういうことだよエクサル
en: That's how it is, Exal.

jp: 自分の命だけじゃない
多くの命がかかってくるんだよ
en: This isn't a game. It's not just your own life. Many lives are riding on it.

jp: そんなに怒らなくても
en: No need to get so angry. I know, I know!

jp: 俺だってそんなにバカじゃない
en: I'm not that stupid.

jp: 一応、あんた達のことは
en: I'll pass word about you two up the chain, at least.
Huh?

jp: あたしも出来る限りは
あんた達に協力してあげるよ
en: And I'll help you as much as I can, myself.
Really? You'd do that?

jp: あたしも大したことは
en: Not that there's much I can do, mind you.

jp: 無茶だけはするんじゃないよ
命は一つしかないんだから
en: ...Just don't go doing anything reckless. You've only got the one life.
Yes, ma'am.
That's enough for today. Off you go.

jp: ありがとうございました
en: Thank you very much.
He's a good kid, isn't he.
Auntie, you're awfully ni~ce today~

jp: あたしはいつだって優しいよ
en: Didn't you know? I'm always nice.

jp: もちろん誰かさんみたいに
無茶ばっかりしているお子様には
en: Though of course, I'm hard on certain children who do nothing but reckless things.
Yeah, yeah.
...Well, I'll be off too.
Hold it, Exal.
Urk!!

jp: あんたのお節介グセは
en: I know all about your meddling habit, but leave this one alone.

jp: 言ってわかる子だったら
苦労はしないんだけどねぇ
en: ...Though if you were the kind to listen, I wouldn't have so much trouble with you.
Auntie?

jp: まだまだお姉さんで通る歳だよ
en: Enough with the 'Auntie'. I can still pass for a big sis.

jp: お姉さんって何歳なの？
en: And how old is 'big sis', exactly?
Mouthy brat. Always one word too many.

jp: ほらほら、見失わないうちに
en: Now go on, hurry, before you lose sight of them.

jp: 今日は目をつぶってあげるから
ほどほどにするんだよ？
en: I'll look the other way today, but keep the nose-poking within reason, you hear?
Huh? Really?

jp: ああ、何か危なくなったら
あんたがあの子達の手助けを
en: Yes. If things get dangerous, you give those kids a hand.
Understood?

jp: サイファーパンクからの
en: Here. Standard issue from Cypherpunk.

jp: ちゃんと持ってきなさい
en: Make sure you take it with you.

jp: おばちゃん、ありがとう！！
en: Thanks, Auntie!! I'm off!!

jp: お姉さんだって言ってるだろう！
en: I said it's big sis!
......Honestly.

jp: あたしもまだまだ甘いねぇ
en: I'm still too soft, aren't I.
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
